card.title: Essays and letters — architecture that carries marks

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Every composition is architecture: essays (250 words, 10 marks) run introduction → thesis → 2–3 developed paragraphs → conclusion; formal letters run sender → date → receiver → subject → salutation → 3-paragraph body → subscription; notices answer what/when/where/who in a box; dialogues alternate speakers with personality intact. Examiners pay for structure, relevance, vocabulary range and accuracy — in that order.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: essay: hook + thesis → PEE paragraphs (Point, Evidence, Explain) → verdict  ·  formal letter: address/date/address/subject/Sir/body×3/Yours faithfully  ·  notice: title + WHAT + WHEN + WHERE + WHO + contact, ~50 words  ·  dialogue: name-colon turns, kept on one topic

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Word limits bind (250-word essay, 100–120-word paragraph, dialogue sustained but bounded) — overshooting wastes time, undershooting loses content marks. Formal register only for formal tasks (no contractions, no slang). Every required detail (health-camp date, venue, contact) must appear — missing one caps the score.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: 'Importance of Reading Books' (NEB 2023, 10 marks): thesis (reading builds mind and language) → paragraphs (knowledge, empathy, language) → verdict. Pokhara excursion letter to a friend (NEB 2022, 10 marks): informal warmth, chronological scenes. Librarian dialogue (NEB 2022, 5 marks): stay on the reserved-book grievance, polite persistence. Health-camp notice (alias bank 2023, 5 marks): all five W-details boxed.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Health-camp notice skeleton: FREE HEALTH CAMP (title) → organised by [school], on [date] at [venue], for [whom] — services listed → contact [name/room]. Five details, fifty words, box drawn. Same checklist method builds the excursion letter (who/when/where/sights/feeling) and the paragraph (topic sentence → causes → effects → closer).

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Templates organise but cannot invent content — empty essays fail regardless of shape. Memorised essays misfire on unseen titles (adapt, don't paste). Over-formality in informal letters and over-familiarity in formal ones both bleed register marks.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: From the mark scheme backward: content (relevance + development) + organisation (paragraphing + cohesion) + language (range + accuracy) → each body paragraph earns its keep with one idea fully developed (PEE), transitions stitch paragraphs, and the conclusion answers 'so what?' — the grader's checklist becomes the writer's outline.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Plan 3 minutes, write to the plan. Essay: thesis first, then paragraphs that prove it. Letters: format memorised cold (losing format marks is free bleeding). Dialogue: voices distinct, topic single. Notice: five W-details, box it.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (10): essay on 'Importance of Reading Books' (~250 words). NEB 2022 (10): friend letter — Pokhara excursion. NEB 2022 (5): student–librarian dialogue. Alias bank 2023 (5): health-camp notice; 2021 (4): mobile-phones paragraph.
